criteria: C1 Format: the reply parses as {answer, memories_used} JSON.
C2 Honest claims: every memory the model says it used was actually sent (validator drops nothing).
C3 Applied when it fits: every memory in should_use is listed as used.
C4 Not over-applied: no memory in should_not_use is listed as used.
_note: A case passes only if all four criteria hold. Cases marked replay=true are the scripted demo prompts (four since 23 Nov 2026, when the work email E04 became a replay scenario); replay mode runs only those. Criteria were written before the system prompt was tuned (Lecture 09: write the criteria first, then score).

cases.prompt: Can you suggest something I could make for dinner tonight?
I don't really understand how solar panels work. Can you explain it properly, step by step?
cases._why: Over-application case (Figure 1): a concise-summary preference from essay revision should not compress a requested step-by-step explanation.

cases.prompt: Can you write a birthday message for my best friend Sam? Something warm and a bit funny.
cases._why: Over-application case: a formal tone requested for an email to a manager should not be applied to a message to a friend.

cases.prompt: Write an email to my manager asking for Friday afternoon off.
Can you give me feedback on my essay intro? 'Computers changed the world. This essay is about the history of computers.'
What's a good recipe for a packed lunch?
Plan a dinner party menu for Saturday. I want to impress my guests and I have all afternoon to cook.
cases._why: Conflict case: the request overrides the stored weeknight time limit.

cases.prompt: Explain how a mortgage works in detail.
Write a thank-you text to my grandmother for the birthday gift she sent.
Summarise the plot of Hamlet in a few lines.
Write a message for my friend Priya, whose grandfather just passed away.
cases._why: Personal message of a kind not in E01-E10: neither the essay bullet-point preference nor the work formal tone should shape it.

cases.prompt: Write a quick text to my flatmate asking them to pick up milk on the way home.
cases._why: Casual text. Until 23 Nov 2026 the task-type keywords missed it ('other'), so only the model's own judgement could avoid the formal tone and a scoped correction for personal messages didn't cover it. It is now classified as a personal message ('flatmate'), which changes this case's result in the corrected condition from that date.

cases.prompt: Write the opening paragraph of a cover letter for a data analyst job.
cases._why: Over-caution check: professional writing where the formal tone SHOULD still apply.

cases.prompt: It's Tuesday and I've just got home from work. What can I make for dinner?
cases._why: Over-caution check: a weeknight dinner where the quick-meals and vegetarian memories SHOULD apply.

_note_held_out: E11-E14 were added on 22 Nov 2026 BEFORE prompt v3 was written, as held-out cases the v3 rules were not designed around. If v3 helps only on E01-E10, it was tuned to the test.
